title: Teen Numbers Are Ten and Some More
short: 14 is ten ones and four more ones.
trouble: Children see 14 as a 1 and a 4 side by side, not as ten and four.

blocks.html: You can write 11 to 20 and make 10. Now see what teen numbers are made of.

blocks.name: tenframe
blocks.cap: 14 is one full ten frame and 4 more.

blocks.name: base10
blocks.cap: The same 14 with blocks: 1 ten-stick and 4 single cubes.

blocks.html: Every teen number is ten and some more: 14 is 10 and 4.
The 1 in 14 does not mean one thing. It means one whole ten. The 4 means 4 more ones.
Seeing 14 as a 1 and a 4 side by side, as if it were 1 thing and 4 things. The 1 is a whole ten! Show 14 with a full ten frame and 4 more to check.
For grown-ups: Bundle 10 straws with a rubber band. Show teen numbers as one bundle and some loose straws.
